content: Xoossa Keeththi Zaari Oosettontta Mala Dendida Seera
Di7eteththafe simmida asay Isra7eele Xoossa Keeththaa keexxishin Yuhuda asaassinne Biniyaame asaas morkke gididayti siyida.

Hessafe dendidayssan Zerubaabelekkonne korapinnetako yiidi «Nunikka intte mala intte Xoossaa goynnizayta; Asoore dere kawo Aseradooney nuna ha biitta ehosofe doommidi izas yarshishenne goynnishe gam7idos; hessa gishshas ha7i nunikka inttenara issife keexxana» gida.

Gido attiin Zerubaabeley, Iyaasoynne korapinneti ubbay «Nu GODAA Xoossa Keeththaa keexxanaas inttena nunara gaththiza miishshi baawa; Paarise kawo Qiroosi nuna azazida mala Isra7eele Xoossa Keeththaa nu nurkka keexxana» gi zaarida.
Hessafe guye he deren diza asati Ayhuda asata hidota qanxxisoninne babison Xoossa Keeththaa keexxontta mala digo oykkida.
Paarise kawo Qiroose kawoteththa layththafe doommidi kawo Daariyoosa kawoteththa layth gakkanaas istti keexxontta mala istta dhupheththanaas zoriza asatas maganxo immida.
Yerusalaame Katamaa Zaareththi Essontta Mala Dendida Seera
Kawo Arxekisisi kawotida koyro layth Yuhudaninne Yerusalaamen de7iza Isra7eele asaa bolla istta morkketi mooto dabdaabbe xaafida.

Paarise kawo Arxekisisi kawotida wode izara Bishilaame, Mitiradaaxu, Xaabi7eelera ooththiza laggeti izara issife gididi mooto dabdaabbe kawo Arxekisises xaafida dabdaabbezi Aramayke qaalaninne pidalen xaafettidi nababettana mala yedettides.
Dere ayssiza Erehuumeynne xaafezi Simisayey Yerusalaame gishshas kawo Arxekisises hayssafe kaallizayssa xaafida.
«Dabdaabbeza xaafiday dere ayssiza Erehuume, xaafeza Simisaye, Elaame biittan diza Suusappe, Erkefenne Baabilooneppe yiidi pirdiza daannatappenne isttara issifeteththi dizaytappe,

qasseka gitanne wolqqama kawo Asinaaferey yelettida dereppe haraso ehidi Samaariya katamaninne Efiraaxise shaafa pinnidi arshey wulliza baggara daana mala woththida hara asatara issife xaafida dabdaabbe» gida.
Dabdaabbezas ayfe yo7oy Kawo Arxekisises, Efiraaxise shaafappe arshey wuliza baggara diza ne oosanchchatappe yedettida dabdaabbey,
«Kawoo! Ne achchafe nuukko yida Ayhuda asati Yerusalaame biidi he iitanne tuna katamayo zaaridi ooso bolla deettes; gimbezakka zaaridi lo7eththoninne yochcha yegeththa bolla deettes.

Hessa gishshas ha katamaya simma oosettikonne izi gimbey gimbetti giigikko asay wuri nees giiriza giiranne qaraxa qanxxonttayssa ne era; ne kawoteththa bonchchos imettiza imotay guuxxi guuxxi baanayssi nees eretto.
Nunikka ne kawoteththafe go7ettizayta gidida gishshas ne bonchchoy boshettishin nu beyishe co7u gaanaas bessenna giidi ha kiita nees yeddidos.

Hessa gishshas kase intte aawata taarikey izan xaafetti diza maxaafay xeelettana mala qofsoos; ha katamaya ubbaa makkallanchcha, kawotassinne deretas meto medhdhiza katama gididayssa ne he maxaafappe demmana; kaseppe doommidi he katamay asay makkallanchcha; katamaya shocetta dhayday hayssa gaasonna.

Hessafe dendidayssan ha katamaya nam7anththo simma oosettikonne izi gimbey gimbetti giigidaappe guye ne kawoteththan Efiraaxise shaafappe he pinththan diza dereta ne ayssanayssi meto gididayssanne nees aykko miishshika he pinththan bayndayssa nu nees qonccisoos» gees.
Kawozikka dabdaabbeza zaaro «Dere ayssiza Erehuumes, xaafeza Simisayes, qasse Samaariyaninne Efiraaxise shaafa pinththan diza nenara issife ooththizaytas saroy gido.
«Intte yeddida dabdaabbey birshetti nababettiin ta siyadis;

hessafe dendidayssan lo7eththi pilggi xeellana mala azazadis; pilggeththan beettiday Yerusalaamey kaseppe doommada kawo kawoteththa bolla makkallashe dizaaro; makkallanchchatasinne iita ooththizaytas gididayssa qonccisees.
Hessika wuri hankkoka Yerusalaamey Efiraaxise shaafappe he pinththan diza dereta qaraxanne giira cigissiza wolqqama kawoti kawotida dere.
Hessa gishshas ta hara azazo kiittana gakkanaas he asati katamaza zaari ooththontta mala yootite.
Nu kawo ooso bolla aykko metoykka gakkontta mala inttes iza alaafeteththaa azallontta naagettite» gi kiittides.
Kawo Arxekisise zaaro dabdaabbey Erehuumes, Simisayessinne isttara ooththizaytas gakki nababettida mala heerakka Yerusalaame biidi katama ooththontta mala asaa wolqqara teqqida.
Hessa gishshas Daariyoosi Paarise deren kawotida nam7anththo layth gakkanaas Xoossa Keeththa oosoy doomettida mala eqqi attides.
